description: This file defines the ClassHelper class with methods to check class existence, retrieve class names with optional namespace fallback, and verify interface implementation for classes or instances within the OrangeHRM Core Plugin.

classes.name: ClassHelper
classes.description: Provides utility methods for class existence checks, class retrieval with fallback namespaces, and interface implementation verification.

methods.name: classExists
methods.description: Checks if a class exists, considering an optional fallback namespace.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name if it exists, with optional namespace fallback.

methods.name: hasClassImplements
methods.description: Verifies if a class or object implements the specified interfaces.
